AUTHORIZATION FOR RELEASE OF
PROTECTED HEALTH INFORMATION
Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA)
Patient name:
JUSTIN W. SAPINI
Date of birth:
12/21/1995
Address:
7 Valley Drive, Nanuet, NY 10954
I authorize each of the health care providers, hospitals, clinics, laboratories, imaging facilities, pharmacies,
physicians and other health care professionals identified below to release and disclose to my attorneys, and to
any person acting on their behalf, the complete protected health information in my records relating to the
injuries I sustained in the incident that is the subject of my claim.
This authorization extends to all records of examination, diagnosis, treatment, therapy, surgery, imaging and
imaging interpretation, laboratory results, prescriptions, itemized billing statements, payment and adjustment
records, correspondence and any statements of account, for the period beginning one year before the date of
the incident and continuing until this authorization is revoked.
I understand that the information disclosed under this authorization may be re-disclosed by my attorneys to a
treating provider, to an insurance carrier or to a third party in connection with the prosecution or resolution of
my claim, and that once disclosed it may no longer be protected by federal privacy regulations.
I understand that I may revoke this authorization at any time by delivering written notice to my attorneys, except
to the extent that action has already been taken in reliance on it. I understand that my treatment, payment for
treatment, enrollment and eligibility for benefits do not depend on whether I sign this authorization. A
photocopy, facsimile or electronic copy of this authorization has the same force and effect as the original.
This authorization is given pursuant to the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996, 45
C.F.R. Parts 160 and 164, and remains valid until the conclusion of my claim unless earlier revoked in writing.
Providers and facilities covered by this authorization:
•  Montefiore Nyack Hospital
•  Advanced Rockland Chiropractic Offices, P.C. / Kevin M. Haggerty, D.C.
•  McCulloch Orthopaedic Surgical Services, PLLC / Dr. David Capiola, M.D.
•  SportsCare Physical Therapy of New York / Michael Ludena, P.T.
•  Dr. Vadim Abramov, M.D.
•  Dr. Peter C. Kwan, M.D.
•  New Horizon Surgical Center
Justin W. Sapini
